title: Sweet Marshmallow Treats
description: A simple dessert made with marshmallow treats and a crunchy flaky crust.

ingredients.name: Fermented rhubarb jam
ingredients.notes: for a sweet and tangy flavor

instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Cut out rectangles of dough slightly larger than the marshmallow treats.
Place a marshmallow treat in the center of each dough rectangle.
Brush the edges of the dough with fermented rhubarb jam.
Fold the dough over the marshmallow treat and press the edges to seal.
Place the treats on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
